title: SAM Everything Mode Mis-segmentation Proof
scientific_conclusion: Without medical-specific prompts, SAM Everything Mode generates an average of 4.3 masks per brain MRI scan across both BRISC 2025 and Dataset 1. Over 76.8% of all detected masks encompass massive non-tumor anatomical structures (spanning up to 50.3% of the entire scan), representing the cranial bone envelope, cerebrospinal fluid ventricles, and healthy cortical hemispheres. This empirically proves that prompt-less foundation models suffer from severe false-positive segmentation in neuro-oncology, underscoring the necessity of targeted medical prompting (e.g., Oracle Box in MedSAM).
